ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a three-phase star-connected load. Phase a is connected to the common node through resistor R, phase b is connected to the common node through an inductive impedance labeled j10, and phase c is connected to the common node through a capacitive impedance labeled -j10; the common node is also connected to n through the neutral line, and the problem requires the neutral-line current to be zero. Reasoning: For the star-connected load in the figure, take each phase current as the current flowing into the common node: Ia = Van/R, Ib = Vbn/(j10), Ic = Vcn/(-j10). Given Van = 100∠0° V, so Ia = 100/R, with direction along the positive real axis. Vbn = 100∠-120° V, therefore Ib = 100∠-120° / 10∠90° = 10∠-210° = 10∠150° = -8.660 + j5 A. Vcn = 100∠-240° = 100∠120° V, therefore Ic = 100∠120° / 10∠-90° = 10∠210° = -8.660 - j5 A. Thus Ib + Ic = -17.320 + j0 A. Zero neutral-line current requires Ia + Ib + Ic = 0, so 100/R - 17.320 = 0, namely R = 100/17.320 = 5.7735 Ω. To two decimal places, R = 5.77 Ω.

method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个三相四线供电的负载连接。左侧有相线 a、c、b 和中性线 n。三条负载支路汇接到右侧的公共节点，该公共节点通过中性线接到 n。a 相到公共节点之间接有电阻 R；b 相到公共节点之间接有标注为 j10 的感性阻抗；c 相到公共节点之间接有标注为 -j10 的容性阻抗。

推理：要求中性线电流为零，则公共节点与电源中性点无电位偏移，可直接用相电压计算各支路电流，并令三相支路电流相量和为零。已知 Van = 100∠0° V，Vbn = 100∠-120° V，Vcn = 100∠-240° V = 100∠120° V。各支路导纳为：a 相电阻支路为 1/R，b 相 j10 支路为 1/(j10) = -j0.1，c 相 -j10 支路为 1/(-j10) = j0.1。因此零中性线电流条件为 Van/R + (-j0.1)Vbn + (j0.1)Vcn = 0，即 100/R + j0.1(Vcn - Vbn) = 0。计算 Vcn - Vbn：Vcn = -50 + j86.6025，Vbn = -50 - j86.6025，所以 Vcn - Vbn = j173.205 = j100√3。于是 j0.1(Vcn - Vbn) = j0.1 × j100√3 = -10√3 A。故 100/R - 10√3 = 0，R = 100/(10√3) = 10/√3 = 5.7735 Ω，取两位小数为 5.77 Ω。
